column1: # Accepted findings of the ZAP baseline (make zap, docs/TESTES.md). Tab separated: rule id, action, reason.
# IGNORE hides the alert; INFO lists it without failing. Any other warning or failure fails the scan.

column3: Words like "select" and "query" in minified Nuxt chunks, not developer comments.
Hashed /_nuxt assets are cached for a year on purpose; pages carry no private data in the HTML.
style-src keeps unsafe-inline for Vue style bindings and the fonts (docs/SEGURANCA.md); removal tracked in #170.
Numbers in the Nuxt payload that look like Unix times, not server timestamps.
Informational: the site is a Nuxt application.
The ZAP image is pinned in infra/zap/compose.zap.yaml; bump it by hand when this shows up.
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy is sent; Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy require-corp would block the Google Maps frame.
